#### Q: How do I offer a buy-feature entry straight into the bonus?
URL: https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/faq/fs-011/
A: Wire a button that skips the trigger and calls your enter-feature path directly — pure game logic.

#### Q: How do I gamble/upgrade the number of free spins before they start?
URL: https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/faq/fs-012/
A: Run the gamble in your UI and set the final spin count before entering — outside the engine.

Wheels, picks, ladders and gamble.

#### Q: How do I run a pick-a-prize bonus on clickable cells?

#### Q: How do I reveal hidden prizes one tap at a time?
URL: https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/faq/bonusgames-002/
A: Same cell hit-areas — reveal each prize in its click handler.

#### Q: How do I spin a bonus wheel and land it on a segment?
URL: https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/faq/bonusgames-003/
A: A wheel is a standalone PixiJS widget, not a reel feature — build it in your game layer.

#### Q: How do I settle the wheel pointer with a believable bounce?
URL: https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/faq/bonusgames-004/
A: Tween the wheel rotation with a GSAP `back.out` ease to settle the pointer — game-layer.

#### Q: How do I offer a gamble / double-up on a win?
URL: https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/faq/bonusgames-005/
A: A gamble / double-up is a standalone screen in your UI; the reel engine is not involved.

#### Q: How do I climb a prize ladder with collect-or-gamble choices?
URL: https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/faq/bonusgames-006/
A: A prize ladder is a game-layer mini-game — build the ladder UI and its collect/gamble logic yourself.

#### Q: How do I run a "pick until you hit 3 of a kind" collection bonus?
URL: https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/faq/bonusgames-007/
A: Cell hit-areas plus your own pick logic tallying matches until three of a kind.

#### Q: How do I award a random multiplier from a chest or orb?
URL: https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/faq/bonusgames-008/
A: Reveal it with your own widget/animation and feed the result into your win math.

#### Q: How do I run a trail / board-game bonus that hops across cells?
URL: https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/faq/bonusgames-009/
A: Tween a token between cells using `getCellBounds` positions; the board-game logic is yours.

#### Q: How do I tally "you collected X" at the end of the pick?
URL: https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/faq/bonusgames-010/
A: Sum the picks in your state and show the total in your UI.

### Meters, multipliers & progression
URL: https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/faq/#meters
Accumulators, level-ups, progressive jackpots.

#### Q: How do I show a multiplier meter above the reels?
URL: https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/faq/meters-001/
A: Render the meter as your own PixiJS/HTML widget above the board; the engine does not own the HUD.

#### Q: How do I increment the meter on each win and reset on a miss?
URL: https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/faq/meters-002/
A: Drive it from win events (or your own round event bus) — increment on a win, reset on a dry spin in your handler.

#### Q: How do I level up a jar/symbol multiplier each time it wins?
URL: https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/faq/meters-003/
A: Track the level in the symbol's pin payload and advance it each win.

#### Q: How do I fill a progress bar that unlocks a feature at 100%?
URL: https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/faq/meters-004/
A: A progress bar is game-layer — fill it from your win events and trigger the feature at 100%.

#### Q: How do I animate a value flying into the meter and bumping it up?
URL: https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/faq/meters-005/
A: `bezierFly` the value to the meter's screen position with `arriveScale` and bump it in the arrival callback. Those helpers are demo code in `apps/site/src/runtime/holdAndWinFx.ts`, not exports of the `pixi-reels` package -- copy them into your project.

#### Q: How do I drive a progressive jackpot value that ticks up live?
URL: https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/faq/meters-006/
A: A progressive value comes from your server feed; animate the ticking number in your UI.

#### Q: How do I show a coin-collect counter that aggregates bonus coins?
URL: https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/faq/meters-007/
A: Aggregate collected coins in your state via `coin:locked` / collect callbacks and show the total.

#### Q: How do I apply the meter's multiplier to the final win?
URL: https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/faq/meters-008/
A: Multiply the win in your math layer; the engine presents whatever cells/values you give it.

#### Q: How do I keep the meter and its server value from drifting apart?
URL: https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/faq/meters-009/
A: Treat the server value as the source of truth and reconcile the displayed meter to it on each response.

#### Q: How do I sticky-stack position-locked multipliers that persist?
URL: https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/faq/meters-010/
A: Pin the multiplier to its cell with a payload so it persists and stacks by position.

### Sound & juice
URL: https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/faq/#audio
Hook sound and haptics to game events.

#### Q: How do I play a sound when a reel stops?
URL: https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/faq/audio-001/
A: Listen for `spin:reelLanded` (or `spin:stopping`) and play the stop sound.

#### Q: How do I play a per-coin sound as each one lands in stagger order?
URL: https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/faq/audio-002/
A: Play it in the `cell:landed` / `coin:locked` handler — they fire in landing (stagger) order.

#### Q: How do I rise the anticipation music as tension builds?
URL: https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/faq/audio-003/
A: Start or raise it when you call `setAnticipation`; drive the layers from your audio engine.

#### Q: How do I duck the music during a big-win count-up?
URL: https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/faq/audio-004/
A: Duck the music in your audio layer when the win roll-up starts (e.g. on `win:start`).

#### Q: How do I pitch the count-up sound higher the longer it runs?
URL: https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/faq/audio-005/
A: Ramp the playbackRate of the count-up sound in your audio code as the total climbs.

#### Q: How do I layer base vs feature music and crossfade between them?
URL: https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/faq/audio-006/
A: Crossfade tracks in your audio engine on the feature swap; the engine just signals the mode change.

#### Q: How do I fire haptics/vibration on a jackpot hit?
URL: https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/faq/audio-007/
A: Fire `navigator.vibrate(...)` in your `coin:locked` / `board:full` handler.

#### Q: How do I sync a sound exactly to a Spine animation event?
URL: https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/faq/audio-008/
A: Add a Spine animation event and play the sound from the skeleton's event listener via the `.spine` getter.

#### Q: How do I cut all feature sounds cleanly when the player exits?
URL: https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/faq/audio-009/
A: Stop your audio in the same teardown that hides the feature / calls `board.destroy()`.

#### Q: How do I keep audio aligned when the player slams the reels?
URL: https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/faq/audio-010/
A: On `skipSpin()`, re-cue or shorten the landing sound — `skip:completed` marks the slammed stop.

### HUD, buttons & overlays
URL: https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/faq/#ui
Spin button, bet, autoplay, counters, tooltips.

#### Q: How do I wire a single spin button that also slam-stops?
URL: https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/faq/ui-001/
A: On tap, `spin()` if idle, else `skipSpin()` (or `requestSkip()` if the result has not arrived yet).

#### Q: How do I disable the spin button while a spin is running?
URL: https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/faq/ui-002/
A: Disable the button on `spin:start` and re-enable when the `spin()` promise resolves (`spin:complete`).

#### Q: How do I show the current bet and balance?
URL: https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/faq/ui-003/
A: Bet and balance live in your game/UI state; the engine does not track money.

#### Q: How do I run autoplay for N spins with a stop condition?
URL: https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/faq/ui-004/
A: Loop `await reelSet.spin()` N times with your own stop conditions.

#### Q: How do I overlay a HUD that reads purely from board events?
URL: https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/faq/ui-005/
A: Subscribe your HUD to the typed `reelSet.events` / `board.events` — they are the single source of truth.

#### Q: How do I draw a value label centered on a specific cell?
URL: https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/faq/ui-006/
A: Position your text at the center of `reelSet.getCellBounds(col, row)` (or `board.cellCenter`).

#### Q: How do I position an overlay using a cell's exact pixel bounds?
URL: https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/faq/ui-007/
A: `reelSet.getCellBounds(col, row)` returns the pixel rect to align any overlay exactly.

#### Q: How do I add clickable hit-areas per cell (pick-a-cell bonus)?
URL: https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/faq/ui-008/
A: Set each cell's `hitArea` / pointer events from `getCellBounds`.

#### Q: How do I keep HUD text crisp at any board scale?
URL: https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/faq/ui-009/
A: Render HUD text at device resolution (high `resolution`) or keep it in a non-scaled HTML/overlay layer.

#### Q: How do I show a "respins left" badge that updates live?
URL: https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/faq/ui-010/
A: Bind it to the `respins:changed` event / `board.respinsLeft`.

#### Q: How do I render the board on a dark feature background vs a light base?
URL: https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/faq/ui-011/
A: Draw the background in your scene per mode; the board renders on top of whatever you provide.

Lines vs ways, bet levels, the paytable screen.

#### Q: How do I switch a game between paylines and ways-to-win?
URL: https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/faq/bet-001/
A: Both are your evaluation choice — the engine lands a grid; you evaluate lines or ways over it.

#### Q: How do I let the player change the bet level?
URL: https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/faq/bet-002/
A: Bet level lives in your game state; pass it to the server and scale values yourself.

#### Q: How do I scale coin values by the current bet?
URL: https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/faq/bet-003/
A: Multiply the coin `data.value` by the bet in your code before displaying it.

#### Q: How do I show a paytable screen for the registered symbols?
URL: https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/faq/bet-004/
A: Build a paytable screen from your registered symbol ids and pays — it is UI, not an engine feature.

#### Q: How do I draw and highlight which lines are active?
URL: https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/faq/bet-005/
A: Draw line overlays with `getCellBounds`; highlighting is your render layer.

#### Q: How do I recompute the ways count when the board shape changes?

#### Q: How do I price the buy-feature off the current bet?
URL: https://pixi-reels.schmooky.dev/faq/bet-007/
A: Compute the buy-feature price from the current bet in your game logic.

#### Q: How do I lock the bet during a feature?
